Japanese and Indian firms pursuing a third-market project

Complementary capabilities need to become one credible offer.

The situation

A Japanese water-treatment technology company and an Indian engineering firm identify an industrial project in Southeast Asia. They need to determine whether their combined offer would meet the buyer’s requirements and how they would deliver it together.

How SetuHashi could help

Assess the opportunity, shape the combined offer, clarify each partner’s contribution and support agreement on commercial terms and delivery coordination.

What the assignment could produce

An opportunity assessment, combined proposal, proposed partner terms and a coordinated delivery plan.

The intended value

An offer designed around an identified customer, with responsibilities and economics understood before commitment.

Related services

  • Pursue customers in other markets together
  • Bring organizations together to deliver
  • Develop workable agreements
